one_line: Website and commerce platform whose Commerce APIs (Orders, Inventory, Products, Fulfillment, Customers, Transactions) integrate store data.
auth_notes: OAuth2 flow against the Squarespace Developer Platform to get access tokens with website scopes (e.g., website.commerce.orders.read), or legacy API keys with scope prefixes (CONTACT, COMMERCE, etc.); Bearer token in Authorization header plus required User-Agent.
self_serve_notes: Free developer account + own site; create an app in the Developer Platform to get API key/OAuth credentials without payment, but Commerce API functionality targets sites on paid commerce plans.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Commerce APIs: Orders, Products, Inventory, Fulfillment, Customers/Contacts, Transactions, Subscriptions, Availabilities, + Commerce Analytics; narrower than Shopify/BigCommerce
api_surface.webhook_note: Commerce webhooks exist for order lifecycle events (order.created, order.updated, fulfillment.updated, etc.) on the Developer Platform

existing_mcp.note: No official Squarespace MCP server found; community servers not verified

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms Commerce API (contacts/orders scope model, Bearer API key or OAuth token, User-Agent requirement) at developers.squarespace.com; broader commerce endpoint set from knowledge

agent_notes: Fetched page detailed the Contacts/Commerce API scope model; commerce breadth and webhooks partially inferred. OAuth + API key both supported.
